decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that builds directly on the firm's coolant-management capabilities in a growing machinery market, it is still an attractive option to keep open while demand and customer fit become clearer.

The centrifuge is closely related to the firm's established process-media offer and likely benefits from its engineering and service network, so management would usually allow more time before judging it unsuccessful.
Coolant nozzles are a small, complementary extension of the core portfolio and should be relatively inexpensive to keep on offer while supporting broader system sales.

Although slightly less central than the core coolant products, the scraper belt chip conveyor still fits the firm's automation and material-flow business, so it would normally be retained unless clear negative evidence emerged.
This magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on the established chip-handling range and matches the firm's strategy of broader, modular production-support solutions, making early withdrawal unlikely.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a plausible adjacent product for this broad machinery supplier, and after only about a year on the market the option value of waiting still outweighs dropping it.
